title: Antam Posts 240% Surge in 1H25 Net Profit, Driven by Nickel and Gold Sales, While Advancing ESG and Downstream Projects
body: PT Antam’s first‑half 2025 net profit jumped 240% to Rp5.14 trillion, largely thanks to nickel sales of Rp7.87 trillion and production of 9.10 Mt wet metric ton, while gold sales reached Rp49.54 trillion and 29,305 kg. The company also advanced its ESG roadmap—cutting scope 1/2 emissions by 15.8%, boosting renewable energy by 10%, rehabilitating 75% of impacted land, and commissioning the SGAR alumina refinery in Mempawah, positioning Antam as a leading downstream player in Indonesia’s mining sector.
